D.treatment: high guidance followed by high guidance (HH)
D.comparison: low guidance followed by low guidance (LL)

O.outcome_detail: understanding of the control of variables strategy across assessments, including a 5-month post-test

cells.quote: Contrary to the frequent claim that a high degree of instructional guidance leads to shallow learning and transfer, across a number of assessments—including a 5-month post-test—the HH group demonstrated a stronger understanding of CVS than the LL group.
cells.note: The study text identifies the four guidance orderings but does not explicitly state the assignment method or setting.

cells.quote: When the survey was repeated in 2015, the overall score increased significantly (p < 0.001) in the 86 HCFs that participated in both surveys [21].
cells.note: This is a repeated healthcare-facility survey comparison reported in the study background, not a learning intervention study.
